view_frame: Front view (XZ plane) showing the vase silhouette. X is width, Z is height. Y is depth (axis of revolution). The part is axisymmetric about the Z axis.

edit_rules: Changing height scales Z coordinates of all vertices.
Changing max_radius scales X coordinates of the widest points.
Changing wall_thickness adjusts the inner profile X coordinates relative to the outer profile.
Changing floor_thickness adjusts the inner profile Z coordinate of the bottom.
